# count_parity -- drmTMB references for Poisson / NB2 `(1 | g)`

Generated by `test/parity/gen_count_ranef_parity.R` (drmTMB 0.7.1, R 4.3.3): simulated data
(`data.csv`) and drmTMB's `opt$par`, sdreport SEs and logLik (`ref.toml`). Numbers and data only;
no drmTMB source is vendored (MIT/GPL boundary, see `test/parity/GENERATING.md`).
Used by `test/test_parity_count_poisson_nb2.jl` (Refs #1073, #1072).

- `poisson_g`: `y ~ x + (1 | g)`, Poisson, 30 groups x 8
- `nb2_g`: `y ~ x + (1 | g)`, `sigma ~ 1`, NB2, 30 groups x 10
